input.quote: 11.1.1.4 Trial Data Package. SFJ shall be the sole and exclusive owner of the Trial Data Package including the Research Results included therein.
input.rationale: The Trial Data Package is defined as all Information generated by or on behalf of either Party in the conduct of the Clinical Trials, including the Clinical Trial Database and the Research Results (p0227), so Section 11.1.1.4 vests ownership of PB's own trial data and work product in SFJ. PB's ownership is restored only if and when it pays the Approval Payments plus a further purchase price (p0663; the Article 14 assignment at p0783 is expressly effective only in accordance with Section 11.1.1.4), and no licence back is granted in the meantime. That fails the fallback, which requires PB to hold a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for its business. Elsewhere the Article is favourable: each Party retains its pre-existing IP (p0650), PB owns all Trial Inventions and Background Materials, and SFJ receives no licence in PB IP beyond what is necessary to perform its obligations (p0666). We therefore propose the fallback licence back rather than reversing ownership, which would require rewriting the purchase mechanic and its many cross-references in Articles 6 and 14.

ops.text: In addition, SFJ hereby grants to PB a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license, with the right to sublicense through multiple tiers, to use and modify the Trial Data Package, including all Research Results, for PB's business.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] SFJ owns the Trial Data Package (all trial data generated by or for PB) until PB pays to buy it back, leaving PB with no right to use its own data in the meantime. We have added our fallback position: a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense that data for PB's business, leaving SFJ's ownership and the purchase mechanic untouched.
proposal.summary: Add a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence back to PB over the Trial Data Package and Research Results.
